d:
24 navanbar 2005 ko nitish kumar ne bihar ki bagdor sanbhali thi. ab jediyu nitish ke 20 sal ke karyakal ko lekar sushasan divas manane ki taiyari kar raha hai. pure bihar men 24 navanbar ko karyakram aayojit hoga. jediyu ke rashtriy karyakari adhyaksh sanjay jha aur pradesh adhyaksh umesh kushvaha se lekar tamam bare neta aise saphal banane men lage hain. vahin samrat chaudhri ki sarkar bhi 21 navanbar ko karyakram karne ja rahi hai, jismen pradhanmantri bhi shamil honge. nitish ke 20 sal banam samrat ke 210 dinon ke karyakal ki tulna bhi hone lagi hai
